name: Volumetric Path Tracing with BSSRDF and Medium Sampling
aliases: Path Tracing with Subsurface Scattering and Participating Media
Subsurface Scattering Integration in Volumetric Path Tracing
summary: This method extends path tracing to render translucent materials in participating media by treating subsurface scattering as surface-to-surface events, bridging geometry and volume transport.
